exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to put, to place, to set, to stand, to station (In a vertical position)
to compel, to force, to make
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: оста́вить — to leave, to leave alone; поста́вить — to put, to place, to set, to stand, to station (In a vertical position); предста́вить — to present, to offer; заста́вить — to compel, to force, to make.
**заставили** — заста́вить (perfective): to compel, to force, to make; to fill, to cram, to jam, to clutter; to block up, to close off. Wiktionary: за- + ста́вить.
